page_title: ESP 1-1 BIL | Espanyol v Athletic Bilbao 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Ruiz de Galarreta I. Hamstring Injury

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' The linesman points to the corner flag, Ath Bilbao are going to take it.

90+5' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Joan Garcia sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. The referee points to the corner flag and Ath Bilbao will take a corner.
90+4' Ath Bilbao fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+4' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
90+1' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pere Milla (Espanyol) comes onto the pitch so that Javi Puado can be given a rest.
88' A corner kick by Ath Bilbao is thwarted by the well prepared Joan Garcia (Espanyol).
86' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
86' The ball goes out for a corner. Ath Bilbao can continue in their attacking effort.
85' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
83' Javi Puado (Espanyol) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) is coming onto the pitch as Jofre cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Here comes a substitution. Exposito (Espanyol) is brought on as a substitute for Pol Lozano.
79' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to make a change. Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) replaces Roberto Fernandez Jaen.
78' Substitution. Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) in, Maroan Sannadi out.

77' 1 - 1 Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the resulting corner and scores with a great header into the roof of the net. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:1.
77' Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
76' A lofted cross from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

74' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
73' One of the Espanyol players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Ath Bilbao will take a free kick.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andoni Gorosabel trots off the pitch and is replaced by Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao).
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) coming on for Yeray Alvarez.
67' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Urko Gonzalez and he is replaced by Fernando Calero (Espanyol).
66' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Joan Garcia intercepts the ball.
65' Ernesto Valverde decides to make a substitution. Benat Prados Diaz will be replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
65' The substitution has been made. Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) has replaced Alex Berenguer.
62' 1 - 0 Goal! Unai Simon makes a huge mistake and Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
60' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play.
58' Javi Puado (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
55' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
53' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
50' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
49' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Joan Garcia, who smothers the ball.
46' The referee is firm and issues Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) a deserved yellow card.
46' Referee Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
45+2' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' A cross from a corner kick by Ath Bilbao is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
45' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
43' 37:63 – the latest ball possession ratio.
41' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
39' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
37' Ath Bilbao showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
35' The corner is swung in but Espanyol can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

34' Jofre (Espanyol) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Espanyol manage to earn a corner.
33' Jofre (Espanyol) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
33' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
32' Referee Guillermo Cuadra sees the trip by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Espanyol will take a free kick near the side line.
31' Javi Puado (Espanyol) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
30' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) serves up a nice cross, but Joan Garcia punches the ball away.
30' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
27' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
25' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
24' Ath Bilbao fail to score from a corner as Joan Garcia (Espanyol) leaps to collect the ball.

24' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Joan Garcia pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going under the crossbar. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner.
24' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
22' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
20' The free kick from long range, taken by Espanyol, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
17' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
16' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
14' Javi Puado (Espanyol) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
13' Surely that's handball by one of the Espanyol players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
11' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
9' Javi Puado (Espanyol) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target.
8' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

7' Jofre (Espanyol) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Unai Simon stops the ball from going into the top of the net. The referee blows his whistle, Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.
5' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
4' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) sends a long ball in, but Joan Garcia comfortably gathers the ball.
3' The free kick into the penalty area from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
2' Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) commits a rough foul. Guillermo Cuadra stops the game and makes a call. Ath Bilbao have a free kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Ath Bilbao will have the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra was nominated as the referee for this game.
